features: 200W DOLBY AUDIO FOR A THEATRE-LIKE EXPERIENCE: Turn your living room into your own soundverse with 200W of output and Dolby Audio. Movie explosions, stadium crowds and background scores come through clearly, so your TV finally sounds as good as it looks

6-DRIVER ACOUSTIC SETUP: Dual 2 inch drivers, a dedicated 48x76mm plus 1.5 inch driver pair and dual 2.25 inch drivers work together to deliver clear dialogue, detailed highs and deep, room-filling bass from one 900mm soundbar

CONNECT EVERYTHING WITH 5 INPUTS: Choose from HDMI ARC, Optical, USB, AUX and Bluetooth v5.3. HDMI ARC gives single-cable setup with your TV, and Bluetooth gives stable wireless streaming from phones and laptops up to 10m away

4 EQ MODES WITH BASS & TREBLE CONTROL: Switch between Movie, Music, News and 3D modes to match what you are watching. Fine-tune the sound with dedicated BASS plus minus and TRE plus minus buttons on the remote, and use the Virtual 3D effect for a wider soundstage

SMART CONTROLS & DIGITAL DISPLAY: Control power, input, volume and playback from the included remote or the side panel. The digital display shows your active mode at a glance and scrolls Dolby Audio when a Dolby signal is detected. Plug in a USB drive to play MP3s directly

WALL-MOUNT READY WITH COMPLETE ACCESSORIES: The slim 900 x 124 x 66 mm design works on a TV shelf or the wall. The box includes the soundbar, remote with AAA batteries, wall mount kit, AUX cable, power cable and user manual with 1-year manufacturing warranty, and auto-reconnect pairs it with your last device instantly
